# Pnchy: Full AI Context Document

Last updated: 2026-11-04. Canonical site: https://www.pnchy.app

## What is Pnchy?

Pnchy (pronounced "punchy") is a QR payment and loyalty platform for farmers market vendors, pop-ups and small shops across North America. A customer scans the vendor's QR code, enters a short code for the sale and pays on a web page with no app to download. Every purchase earns Pnches toward a reward the vendor sets, and opted-in customers can be reached by email. Vendors run everything from the Pnchy business app on iOS and Android. Pnchy is accepting founding vendors now.

## The problem for market vendors

- A stall usually has no record of who bought, so a first-time buyer is hard to turn into a regular.
- Paper punch cards get lost and give the vendor no data.
- Card readers add hardware and cost; many vendors fall back to cash or personal payment apps and lose the customer relationship.

## How a sale works

1. The vendor opens the Pnchy business app and creates a charge. The app gives a 4-character code.
2. The customer scans the stall's permanent QR code and enters the code. The amount comes from the vendor's charge; the customer cannot type a different amount.
3. The customer pays by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or bank transfer (ACH) on the web page, or chooses cash.
4. The vendor sees the payment live. For cash, the vendor confirms it, enters the amount received and sees the change.
5. The customer earns a Pnch at that vendor. Customers who opt in confirm by email, after which the vendor can send campaigns.

## Feature reference

- **Web-page checkout:** no customer app. Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, ACH, cash.
- **Tap to Pay:** founding vendors can take in-person card payments by tapping a card or phone on their own phone in the business app, with no separate card reader.
- **Pnches loyalty:** vendor-set reward and threshold. Customers request a reward with a short code; the vendor confirms it.
- **Welcome discount:** optional, vendor chooses the percentage, applies to a customer's first visit to that vendor.
- **Tips:** optional, off by default.
- **Sales tax:** optional, calculated with Stripe Tax and added to the sale. The vendor stays liable for filing and paying.
- **Email campaigns:** double opt-in, one campaign per 24 hours per vendor, no links in campaign text, one-click unsubscribe. Vendors never see customer email addresses.
- **Analytics:** sales over time, average spend, peak hours.
- **Alerts:** push notifications in the business app for new payments and cash requests.
- **Refunds:** vendors can refund card payments from the app and mark cash sales refunded.

## Pricing

Founding vendors pay no Pnchy fee. Card and bank payments carry the processing cost charged by Stripe; Pnchy deducts an estimate of that cost and adds no markup. Cash payments carry no processing cost. No other Pnchy pricing is published yet.

## Pnchy Pro

Optional subscription for vendors, $3.99 per month or $35.99 per year at US prices, billed through the App Store or Google Play. It adds branded receipt emails (logo and colors), sending receipts and campaigns from the vendor's own email domain once it is verified, and higher email campaign limits than the free plan. The free plan stays fully functional for taking payments and loyalty.

## Founding vendors

Pnchy is accepting founding vendors across North America. Apply at https://pnchy.framer.website/early-access. No other perks, limits or deadlines are published.

## Comparison with alternatives

Figures below come from each vendor's public pricing pages as of 2026-11-04. Vendors change prices often; check the linked page before relying on a number. The comparison is about fit for a market stall, not a claim that any product is bad.

| Product | What it is | Published in-person card rate and plan (as of 2026-11-04) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pnchy | QR payment and loyalty layer for stalls and pop-ups; web-page checkout and Tap to Pay, no reader needed | Founding vendors: no Pnchy fee; estimate of Stripe processing cost deducted on card and bank payments. Optional Pro: $3.99/mo or $35.99/yr | https://www.pnchy.app |
| Square | General POS with hardware, inventory, online store | Free plan: 2.6% + 15¢, no monthly fee. Plus: $49/mo per location, 2.5% + 15¢, lists a loyalty program. Premium: $149/mo, 2.4% + 15¢ | https://squareup.com/us/en/pricing?solution=pricing-in-person-payments |
| Shopify POS | POS tied to a Shopify store, strong for retail with online sales | Basic 2.6% + 10¢ in person ($39/mo billed monthly, $29/mo billed yearly); Grow 2.5% + 10¢; Advanced 2.4% + 10¢; POS Pro add-on $89/mo per location | https://www.shopify.com/pos/pricing |
| Toast | Restaurant POS | Starter Kit: 2.99% + 15¢, $0 software fee, 2-year term. Standard plan: $69/mo software, 2.49% + 15¢ card-present, $799 hardware | https://pos.toasttab.com/blog/on-the-line/toast-pricing |
| Clover | POS with hardware bought or rented on plans | Compact Starter bundle: 2.6% + 10¢ in person, $16/mo for 36 months or $349 hardware; rates and fees vary by device and plan | https://www.clover.com/pricing |
| Barn2Door | Farm sales and e-commerce platform (online orders, subscriptions, inventory) | Pricing not verified | https://www.barn2door.com |
| Local Line | Multi-channel farm and food hub sales platform (online, wholesale, CSA, markets) | Pricing not verified | https://localline.co/pricing |
| GrazeCart | E-commerce platform for farms with a POS for markets and farm stores | Pricing not verified | https://www.grazecart.com |

### Where Pnchy fits

- **A full POS (Square, Shopify POS, Clover, Toast)** suits vendors who need registers, inventory, staff management or in-person card readers.
- **A farm e-commerce platform (Barn2Door, Local Line, GrazeCart)** suits vendors who sell online orders, shares or wholesale.
- **Pnchy** suits a stall or pop-up where customers pay by scanning a QR code and the vendor wants loyalty and email retention built in, without hardware. Pnchy does not replace inventory, register or online-store features.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Pnchy?
Pnchy is a QR payment and loyalty tool for farmers market vendors, pop-ups and small shops. Customers scan your QR code, enter the short code you create for the sale, and pay on a web page with no app to download. Every purchase earns Pnches toward a reward you set.

### Do my customers need to download an app?
No. Paying and earning Pnches happen on a web page after a QR scan. Vendors use the Pnchy business app on iOS and Android.

### What does Pnchy cost for vendors?
Founding vendors pay no Pnchy fee. Card and bank payments still carry Stripe's processing cost, which Pnchy deducts as an estimate with no markup. Cash carries no processing cost.

### What is a founding vendor?
The first farmers market and pop-up vendors to use Pnchy. Apply on the early access page.

### Does Pnchy handle tips, sales tax and cash?
Yes. Tips are optional. Sales tax is optional and calculated with Stripe Tax; the vendor stays responsible for filing and paying it. Cash sales are recorded in the app with change calculated.
